title: Calendar Events Automatically Deleted (16.09.26)
body:
Extremely disappointed with this Calendar app. On 16.09.26, all my saved calendar events suddenly disappeared without warning. These were important events that I had carefully saved, and losing them automatically is completely unacceptable.
Although My iCloud has insufficient storage, but this issue is not related to iCloud storage limitations. The app should protect users' data and ensure that saved events remain safe and accessible.
A calendar app is supposed to help users organize their schedules, not randomly delete important information. There should be a reliable recovery option and a clear explanation of why this happened.
author: June Hoe 61

title: Automatically DELETE ALL Event Data
body:
On 28 Aug 2026, my iPhone 17 running iOS 26.6 suddenly showed that the storage was full, and almost all apps stopped working. I deleted some photos to free up space and restarted my phone.

After that, I was shocked to find that ALL my Calendar events had disappeared — even my iCloud Calendar was completely empty!

I checked with several iPhone community groups and found that many other users have experienced the same issue when their iPhone storage was almost full.

How can such a serious bug happen? Running out of storage should NEVER result in users losing important data!

I paid so much for an iPhone because I expected reliability, not this kind of ridiculous problem. I’m extremely angry and disappointed with Apple. This is totally unacceptable!
